name: gap-two-column-merged
description: Rohtak hardware shop, single side, classic two-column layout: LEFT column = shop block (caps name, tagline, address, landline), RIGHT column = person block (name, designation, mobile, email). Tesseract read it row-wise, so EVERY line contains a left-column fragment and a right-column fragment separated only by a wide run of spaces (no pipe, no bullet). Row pairing is arbitrary: the person's name shares a line with the shop name, the designation with the tagline, the mobile with the street, the e-mail with the city line. Address has NO PIN at all ('Rohtak (Haryana)' — city + bracketed state only) and the street line has no comma. Also: 'Deals in :' tagline, 'Timing : 9 AM - 8 PM' with am/pm, 'PAN : ABCPG1234K', 'Mo.' abbreviation for mobile, and one right-column fragment that is a bare 'WhatsApp' word left over from an icon label.
